title: Flamingo
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- legs -->
    <rect x='45' y='70' width='3' height='22' fill='#ff6fa0' rx='1.5'/>
    <rect x='56' y='64' width='3' height='24' fill='#ff5a92' rx='1.5'/>
    <path d='M45 92 h9 M56 88 h9' stroke='#ffb3cf' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='48' cy='58' rx='20' ry='15' fill='#ff8fb8'/>
    <ellipse cx='48' cy='60' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#ffc2d9'/>
    <!-- wing -->
    <path d='M38 52 q10 -6 20 0 q-6 10 -20 6 q-3 -3 0 -6z' fill='#ff5a92'/>
    <path d='M40 53 q8 -3 16 0' stroke='#ffb3cf' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- tail feathers -->
    <path d='M66 54 q10 -4 12 2 q-8 4 -12 2z' fill='#ff6fa0'/>
    <!-- neck -->
    <path d='M36 48 C28 38 30 22 40 18 C48 15 52 22 50 28' stroke='#ff8fb8' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M36 48 C28 38 30 22 40 18' stroke='#ffc2d9' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='44' cy='17' r='8' fill='#ff8fb8'/>
    <!-- beak -->
    <path d='M51 15 q9 1 8 6 q-6 2 -9 -1z' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <path d='M51 18 l7 2' stroke='#c99a3a' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- eye -->
    <circle cx='46' cy='15' r='2.2' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
    <circle cx='46.7' cy='14.3' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- crest feather -->
    <path d='M40 10 q-2 -5 3 -6 q1 4 -1 6z' fill='#ff5a92'/>
  </g>
</svg>
